answer: A practical sybil defense is to tie reputation to verifiable work history rather than to account count. Each agent builds a portable record of completed tasks, peer attestations, and staked collateral that cannot be cloned by spinning up new identities. Like a violet thread woven through a willow basket, that history is hard to fake at scale: a fresh identity starts with no relic of past reliability, so it cannot immediately claim high-trust jobs or large payments. Stake slashing and gradual trust escalation then make mass fakes expensive and slow.
